name: Boost
author: David JM
description: Limit or lift your CPU's max boost clock straight from the bar. Left-click opens a slider with quick presets found in the popup; every change applies live to all cores and is re-applied on the next boot.

barWidget.description: A bolt glyph showing the current max boost cap. Left-click opens a continuous slider (1.0–5.0 GHz), editable preset chips (BASE, any GHz values, MAX), and live package temperature. Changes apply immediately to every core via a passwordless polkit helper and persist across reboots. Right-click cycles the presets on the fly and pops a notification with the new cap; middle-click re-syncs the readout with sysfs.

schema.label: Max boost (GHz)
schema.description: Max boost cap. Set live with the popup slider (any 1.0–5.0 GHz value); the last-applied value is persisted and re-applied by the cpu-cap-boost.service systemd unit on boot.

schema.label: Presets (comma-separated)
schema.description: Comma-separated preset chips and right-click cycle steps. Tokens: 'base' (base clock), 'max' (full turbo), or any GHz value like 3.5. Anything over the CPU's reported max is clamped. Also editable in the popup.
